title: Carry the organization in the request path
description:
**Phase 3 of 7.** SERIALIZE. Do not run this concurrently with other Python work.

- **Blocked by:** 1ebc7d
- **Runs in parallel with:** nothing. See the warning below
- **Unblocks:** 7b4616

---
**Scheduling warning.** This reshapes nearly every route in python/src/chatticus/http/app.py and the tenant column in most files under features/. It is unblocked as soon as the Principal seam merges, but it needs a clear window: one agent, one pull request, merged fast. Anything else in flight against those files will conflict badly. Land it before or after the other phase-3 tasks, not during.

Routes become /orgs/{tenant_id}/... and the authorization check is uniform: is this principal a member of the organization named in the path. Delete X-Tenant-Id from web/lib/api.ts and web/lib/sse.ts and stop accepting it at the front door. Never resolve an ambient current organization from the session; every request states which organization it is for.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Reviewed #137. This is the cleanest change in the initiative so far, and I have no defect to report.**

The organization enters in exactly one place: `APIRouter(prefix="/orgs/{tenant_id}")`, with thirty routes on it and `/health` the only route left on the app. That matches the seam 1ebc7d defined, where `/health` and the authentication routes sit outside the marker system entirely. There is no ambient current-organization anywhere; every request states which organization it is for, as the card required.

**Rejecting the header rather than ignoring it was the right call.** The middleware returns 400 with a message naming the replacement path. A silently ignored header would let a stale client appear to work while its tenant assertion was quietly dropped, which is the worst possible failure for an authorization boundary. Failing loudly with instructions is better, and `features/org_path_routing.feature` asserts the rejection rather than trusting it.

The migration is complete rather than partial, which is what I checked hardest. `SameOriginApiClient` posts to `/orgs/{tenant_id}/turns/{turn_id}/claim`, and both `web/lib/api.ts` and `web/lib/sse.ts` route through one `orgApiPath` helper with the header gone and `/health` correctly left unprefixed. `tenantId` still comes from `web/lib/config.ts`, which is right; removing that constant belongs to 22f5bb.

Scope held: no `resolve_principal` in app.py, no enforcement, no 401s. Enforcement still flips once, at 7b4616.

**One thing to carry into d71ed5.** Because the header is now rejected rather than ignored, anything still sending it fails immediately rather than at the join. The in-repo clients are migrated and CI is green, but CI never touches real AWS, so the live acceptance path against a named environment is unverified from here. When d71ed5 adds worker credentials, confirm it also fixed the path, not only the auth. Those are two separate breakages and only one of them is that card's title.
